screenshots.description: Three-pane patient chart overview for demo patient Will Darcy (DOB 01/01/1990). Left patient banner, top toolbar (Visit Note, Notes, Rx, Orders, etc.), center Requiring Action / Chronological Record, right Clinical Reminders and visit note.
Full Elation EMR chart for demo patient Will Darcy (DOB 01/01/1990) showing patient demographics, allergies, problem list, clinical reminders, vitals and subjective/objective note.
Elation EMR patient chart for demo patient Paula Patient (DOB 08/29/1937), with insurance Medicare, problem list, allergies, and chronological record with office visit note.
Elation EMR full chart (laptop frame) for demo patient Helen M. Carnegie (DOB visible) showing problem list, allergies, subjective/objective note and clinical decision support panel.
Elation EMR full chart for demo patient Scrooge P. McDuck (DOB, insurance Medicare) showing chronological record of imaging/lab results with Lab Requisition and Imaging Requisition modal forms.
